title: INRGIFT in 60 seconds
transcript: INRGIFT is a research view of global markets, built from India.
Trading sessions are shown on India time, with each market’s status.
Markets lists every covered exchange with its session and index.
The global heatmap sizes assets by value and colours them by change.
The screener filters stocks, ETFs and REITs on more than thirty metrics.
Compare puts up to four assets side by side on one rebased chart.
Research notes describe the data, with sources, limitations and method.
